assignment.name: Field trip Poster - Learning Portfolio
assignment.description:
Dear all

As discussed in class, the details of the poster assessment are uploaded here.

UCUG3801_fieldposter.pdf

Poster fitting to a Movable Screen (9:16, recommended 1080*1920 or higher)

You only need to submit the e-form, usually a PDF form. We will print the poster for you before class. Please make sure your poster is print-ready and clearly readable. 

 

Best
